text: Butter is boiled, skimmed, strained, salted and sealed in a jar to age. Wikipedia names no microbes and no ageing times, so none are given here.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: Sealed and traditionally buried, it ferments and grows stronger smelling, the older the more valued.

processing.text: Thyme is often added as a yeast and enzyme starter; the salted butter ferments sealed in a jar, traditionally buried, and grows stronger with age. No microbes or times are named.
